target.title: fix(agent): return data URIs for workspace-relative identity card avatars (#97602)
target.body: ## Summary `agent.identity.get` resolved workspace-relative agent avatars via `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl` to `/avatar/` route URLs. The Control UI Personal card renders those URLs in `` tags, which cannot carry Bearer auth headers — the images always show broken (401). This PR reads the validated local avatar file into a data URI inline, so the browser can render it directly. Remote HTTP URLs, existing data URLs, and missing avatars are untouched. Fixes #97602. ## What Problem This Solves The Personal card in Control UI shows a broken avatar image because `agent.identity.get` returns `/avatar/` (a path requiring Bearer auth), while `agents.list` correctly resolves workspace-relative avatars to data URIs or serves them through the authenticated HTTP endpoint. Since `` tags cannot carry Authorization headers, the Personal card always gets 401. Concretely, given a workspace directory with an avatar file `avatar.png`: - **Before**: `agent.identity.get` → avatar = `/avatar/main` (route URL → `` 401) - **After**: `agent.identity.get` → avatar = `data:image/png;base64,...` (inline data URI → `` renders correctly) ## Why This Change Was Made The fix is minimal and layered in the correct place: 1. **`readLocalAvatarDataUrl`** in `identity-avatar.ts`: reads a validated local avatar file and returns a data URI, reusing the existing `isPathWithinRoot` boundary checks. Returns `null` on any failure (missing file, outside workspace, too large, unsupported extension) — callers fall back to the existing route URL. 2. **`agent.identity.get`**: when `resolveAgentAvatar` returns `kind: "local"`, converts the file to a data URI before passing it to `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl`. If the conversion fails, the route URL is used as the existing fallback. The HTTP avatar endpoint (`/avatar/`) in `control-ui.ts` is untouched — it continues to serve raw file bytes for authenticated requests. ## Changes - `src/agents/identity-avatar.ts`: added `readLocalAvatarDataUrl(filePath, workspaceDir, maxBytes?)` — reads a workspace-validated local avatar file into a `data:` URI. - `src/agents/identity-avatar.test.ts`: added 3 tests for the new function (valid file → data URI, outside workspace → null, missing file → null). - `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts`: `agent.identity.get` now converts local avatars to data URIs in the response. ## User Impact Control UI Personal card avatars render consistently when the avatar source is a workspace-relative local file. Users no longer see broken images or 401s in the identity card. Remote URLs, existing data URLs, text fallbacks, and the `/avatar/` HTTP endpoint are all unaffected. ## Evidence ### 1. Real setup transcript (standalone script, real code) A standalone script creates a workspace with a valid PNG avatar file, calls the new `readLocalAvatarDataUrl`, and compares the output with the current `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl` route URL: ``` BEFORE (route URL): /avatar/main AFTER (data URI): data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUg==... is data URI: true ``` Before: a route URL that `` cannot load. After: a data URI the browser renders directly. ### 2. Regression tests ``` Test Files 2 passed (2) Tests 32 passed (32) ``` New `readLocalAvatarDataUrl` tests cover the valid-file, outside-workspace, and missing-file cases. All existing `resolveAgentAvatar` and `resolvePublicAgentAvatarSource` tests pass unchanged. `oxlint` on all changed files passes clean. ## AI-assisted This PR was AI-assisted (Claude Code). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Co-Authored-By: Claude
